purpose: Paired 64/256 pixel evidence on visual prediction, coordinate anchoring and SI mechanics

KeyCLD.architecture: native encoder, renderer, point masses, potential, input matrix and hard constraints
KeyCLD.memory: stream entire sequences; rematerialize per-frame independent CNNs; one update after complete loss

CON.architecture: native beta-VAE stride (1,1), 8D CON-IAE, 14D command, original dense layers
CON.loss: complete upstream beta-VAE and 48-step dynamical reconstruction; MSE already pixel-averaged
CON.memory: stream batches; large-memory GPU preflight required; never silently resize inputs or replace dense layers

selection: fixed final epoch; no test selection; each resolution trained from scratch
exact_state_controls: reuse frozen resolution-independent state runs; do not count as new high-resolution training

public_reader.calibration_and_verification: same assembly-disjoint halves of the 54 independent calibration sequences
controls: frozen model RGB through that same reader
public_reader.failure_action: optimize the measurement chain on development identities and repeat independent calibration if instrument error can change the conclusion

scoring.main: 100/6 times the family/condition/seed-balanced sum of measurable component scores
scoring.missing: zero contribution; retain all registered cases and six-component denominator
